overview_description.description:
Acunote is a project management and Scrum software made by Pluron, Inc. (DBA Acunote), a web startup based in Silicon Valley. 

Acunote provides companies with the ability to manage software development, online project management and IT project management for the whole company. It is fast and easy to use, shows actual progress, provides powerful analytics, works for the whole company as a unified project means of communication and collaboration tool and integrates well with existing tools.

product.name: Acunote Online Project Management and Scrum Software
product.description: A cloud-based tool for managing projects, sprints, backlogs, and tasks using Agile and Scrum methodologies, suitable for teams of all sizes.

product.name: Acunote Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Analytics tools providing burndown charts, progress tracking, and data-driven reports for projects, sprints, teams, and the entire organization.

product.name: Acunote Integration Services
product.description: Integration capabilities connecting Acunote with source control systems and bug trackers like GitHub, Bitbucket, JIRA, and Bugzilla.

product.name: Acunote Wiki and Collaboration Features
product.description: Built-in wiki system for projects and tasks to document requirements, procedures, and support team collaboration.

product.name: Acunote Access Control and Security
product.description: Access control settings to restrict project visibility and manage user permissions within the organization.
